entities.summary: Dillon Simpson is a Canadian former professional ice hockey defenceman who is currently an assistant coach for the University of North Dakota Fighting Hawks. He was selected by the Edmonton Oilers in the fourth round of the 2011 NHL Entry Draft. He is the son of former NHL forward Craig Simpson.
